projects.title: cr3te.it

projects.title: iTerm2 System Monitor Widget
projects.description: A widget with various system monitoring functions (CPU, RAM, network, ...) for iTerm2

projects.title: Purrrfect
projects.description: A cat Sudoku clone!

projects.title: Cat vs. Dog
projects.description: Four games for two games, against boredom on the phone.

projects.title: 7even

projects.title: BÖRT

projects.title: Header Mirror

projects.title: OSINT Tool Directory
